rows.grounds: absolutive of saṃpuṭī-kṛ; hands are brought into a cupped shape
dual accusative masculine adjective-noun compound describing two spread fingers

items.question: How should the practitioner position the fingers after cupping the hands in this mudra?
items.inference: cupped hands with spread fingers form the mudra
items.plain_english: Cup the hands, spread the fingers, and hold the gesture thus.
